description: PlayerDensity conformance: what the player shows around the sentence being read, from the text scale (1.0 = the system's default text size; iOS: the scaled body size / 17, Android: the font scale). At large text the sentence being read keeps the room: the sentences before and after it and the book title go, and the chapter header takes one line. Run by both cores.

cases.name: iOS xxxLarge, the largest non-accessibility size
